description: An oil-style painting of a bearded man in a dark long coat, leaning over a workbench with both hands on an electric machine. The machine has a copper-wound drum, a visible spark at the contact point, and a belt-driven pulley. Behind him are coiled cables, a glowing lantern, gears and a window. The scene looks like a late-19th-century workshop. No text or signature is visible, and the painting runs edge to edge with no frame.
